connections.name: Gmail
connections.how: Connect the office Gmail in Workspace, Connected apps. Each person signs in on their own screen.

connections.name: Redbark bank link
connections.how: Connect Redbark in Workspace, Connected apps, so Bud can read the ANZ rows. Without it, add the ANZ CSV in the bank review.

connections.name: REI Cloud
connections.how: Sign in to REI Cloud in RealBud's work browser when Bud asks. Bud never sees or types the password.

rules.text: Maintenance checks count invoices per calendar month by the date the email was received.
Inspections follow a six-month cycle from the last completed inspection.

plan.reads: The ANZ rows from Redbark, or the ANZ CSV you add in the bank review, and the saved REI tenant list.
plan.waitsFor: Your review of rows it could not match, then your REI Cloud sign-in in the work browser. Other workflows keep running while it waits.
plan.notifies: Accounts: a card in Work and a desktop notification when it needs you.
plan.approval: Uploading the reviewed file to REI is asked each time and shows the exact file. Processing the receipts stays with you in REI.

plan.reads: Bill emails and PDFs in the reviewed Gmail scope, and the saved property rate and levy numbers.
plan.waitsFor: Your review of new bills and suggested patterns. No sign-in is needed.
plan.notifies: Accounts: new bills to review and expected bills that have not arrived.
plan.approval: Nothing is paid or sent. Accepting a bill is your decision.

loops.note: Starts at 7:30 so the list is ready by about 8:00. The time is when Bud starts, not a promise of when it finishes.

plan.reads: New and unresolved mail in the reviewed Gmail scope since the last check.
plan.waitsFor: Nothing. It prepares a list for you and keeps your earlier decisions.
plan.notifies: The person whose mail it is: "Morning priorities ready".
plan.approval: Nothing is sent, archived or relabelled.

plan.reads: Reviewed maintenance bills and the saved REI supplier list.
plan.waitsFor: Nothing. You see the findings when you are ready.
plan.notifies: Property manager: senders Gmail could not verify, and several invoices for one property in a calendar month.
plan.approval: Nothing is paid or changed. You mark findings seen or dismiss them.

plan.reads: REI Cloud's supplier list, read-only, in the work browser.
plan.waitsFor: Your REI Cloud sign-in, like the bank import.
plan.notifies: Property manager: suppliers added, removed or changed in REI.
plan.approval: Saving the changed supplier list on this PC. Nothing is changed in REI.

plan.reads: Your inspection rules, the saved inspection history and the properties on Desk.
plan.waitsFor: Your review of the draft. Accepted and moved visits stay where you put them.
plan.notifies: Property manager: "New inspection draft ready to review".
plan.approval: Nothing is booked. Property Inspect is not connected yet.
